design: A/B/C/D/E; paired training seeds 0, 1 and 2, 200 epochs at 480.
prior_exposure: The A/B/E test results were seen before the user requested this extension. The validation split and thresholds and the held-out split are unchanged. No C/D test result exists at registration.
primary: At OpenVINO FP32, 480, one-to-one, Q is mAP50–95. Interaction in pp = 100*((D-B)-(C-A)), with seedwise differences and their mean.
gate: At top-down P4/P3 concat: global average pooling, shared per-site two-layer MLP with descriptor width/16 and ReLU, zero final weights/bias, 2*softmax. Both backbones use identical gate initialization for each seed.
latency: Measure every checkpoint in the same new 87-cell rotation per split, including the nine existing checkpoint files; three sessions with 200 warmups and 1000 timed observations per boundary.
uncertainty: Matched group bootstrap, 1000 shared draws at seed 5122026, seed-specific estimates and equal-seed paired mean; test-set intervals are conditional on trained seeds.
scope: 60 one-to-one resolution cells and 21 matched head pairs per split; PyTorch runtime comparison A/E.
